## Changes

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the checks performed, their results, and any remaining limitations. Link the CI run when available.

## UI screenshots

For changes to rendered UI, embed screenshots directly in this description. Use generated samples or synthetic documents without personal information. For changes without a visual impact, write "Not applicable" and explain why.

- [ ] Show the affected states, with before/after captures when an existing layout or interaction changes.
- [ ] Include desktop and mobile viewport sizes and record their dimensions.
- [ ] Include light and dark appearances where affected.
- [ ] Identify the application commit captured; refresh images when the UI changes.
- [ ] Use durable image links that remain available after CI artifacts expire. A downloadable ZIP alone is not sufficient.

| State and viewport | Before, when applicable | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Describe the captured state | Embed image | Embed image |

Screenshots support visual review. Record keyboard, accessibility, and functional checks separately under Validation.

## Review notes

Describe dependencies on other PRs, known limitations, and any decisions that need reviewer attention.
